entities.name: Monastery of Our Lady of Mount Carmel in Haifa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Monastery of Our Lady of Mount Carmel is a Catholic Christian monastery for Carmelite nuns that sits on the slope of Mount Carmel, in Haifa, Israel. The monastery is dedicated to Our Lady of Mount Carmel.
